Harbour Notes
=============

An invented harbour, described in headings of every rank the reader knows:
the title underlined with equals signs, the ranks below it opened with
number signs.

## The quay

The quay runs the length of the harbour and ends at a lamp.

### Moorings

Twelve rings are set into the quay wall, one every few metres.

#### Winter moorings

Boats moved to the inner basin for the winter.

##### The inner basin

The basin is sheltered by the old breakwater.

###### The breakwater

Its stones were laid without mortar.
